wire.guardrails.critical_override.help: Off by default. On sends critical deletions (state dir, config, secrets, home) to the safety check instead of refusing them. Only honoured when set from this machine's settings, never from a file edit.
wire.guardrails.critical_override.label: Review critical deletions
wire.guardrails.enabled.help: Applies your guardrail rule files to tool calls before they run. The built-in dangerous-delete check stays on either way.
wire.guardrails.enabled.label: Guardrail rules
wire.guardrails.judge_timeout_s.help: How long the safety check may take before the call is blocked. A check that cannot answer always blocks.
wire.guardrails.judge_timeout_s.label: Safety check timeout (s)
wire.guardrails.rules_dir.help: An extra folder of guardrail rule files (*.md), loaded in addition to the rules folder in the config directory.
wire.guardrails.rules_dir.label: Rules folder
wire.guardrails.section.description: Checks that run before a tool call and can refuse dangerous ones.
wire.guardrails.section.title: Guardrails
